symbol.desc: A goat with swept horns, sideways ears, a narrow muzzle, beard and cloven hooves.
A donkey with very long upright ears, broad muzzle, short mane and tasseled tail.
A round pig with folded ears, oval snout, little trotters and a curly tail.
A fluffy sheep with scalloped wool, floppy ears, a little face and narrow legs.
A cow with curved horns, wide ears, spotted coat, rounded muzzle and little bell.
A horse with pointed ears, flowing mane, long nose, hooves and swishing tail.
A chicken with red comb, pointed beak, feathery tail, wing and three-toed feet.
A squat duck with broad flat bill, rounded wing, uplifted tail and webbed feet.
A goose with long curved neck, small head, pointed bill, long wing and webbed feet.
A friendly dog with floppy ears, rounded muzzle, paws and a wagging tail.
A cat with pointed ears, whiskers, an arched tail and triangular nose.
A round hamster with tiny ears, bulging cheeks, little paws and small front teeth.
A mouse with oversized ears, pointed snout, whiskers and a long curling tail.
A parrot with hooked beak, eye patch, layered wing, long tail feathers and grasping feet.
A rabbit with long upright ears, rounded cheeks, buck teeth, big hind paws and a cotton tail.
A fox with tall triangular ears, a pointed cheek ruff and a sweeping bushy white-tipped tail.
A raccoon with a rounded eye mask, little paws and a thick striped curling tail.
A squirrel with tufted ears, tiny hands holding an acorn and an oversized curled tail.
A slender deer with branching antlers, leaf-shaped ears, a pale chest and spotted shoulders.
A broad bear with rounded ears, a soft oval muzzle, short legs and a large round belly.
A hedgehog with a crown of pointed spines, tiny ears, a light face and tucked little paws.
An owl with ear tufts, enormous round eyes, folded scalloped wings and a feathered belly.
A panda with round dark ears, slanted eye patches, contrasting arms and a large light belly.
A red panda with white cheek patches, triangular pale-rimmed ears and a broad ringed tail.
A wolf with erect ears, a broad angular cheek ruff, pale muzzle and a low bushy tail.
A spotted leopard with rounded ears, rosette spots, a pale muzzle and a curling spotted tail.
A tiger with rounded ears, bold forehead and cheek stripes, a striped body and curved tail.
A lion with a full scalloped mane, rounded ears, a pale muzzle and a tufted tail.
A monkey with large round ears, a heart-shaped face, long arms and a curled prehensile tail.
A gorilla with a high brow, broad shoulders, long knuckle arms and a squared muzzle.
An orangutan with very long shaggy arms, broad cheek pads and a small expressive pale face.
A wild boar with a bristled ridge, angular ears, a broad snout and two curling tusks.
A moose with broad palmate antlers, wide ears, a long heavy muzzle and hanging throat bell.
A bison with a massive shoulder hump, shaggy head, small curved horns, beard and short sturdy legs.
A sleek panther with small round ears, a slim neck, long forelegs and a high curling tail.
A beaver with small round ears, buck teeth, little hands and a broad crosshatched paddle tail.
A slender llama with long banana-shaped ears, an upright neck, narrow face and long cloven legs.
A fluffy alpaca with a woolly forelock, short ears, soft rounded body and short sturdy legs.
A kangaroo with long upright ears, powerful haunches, a small belly pouch and a long balancing tail.
A koala with large fluffy ears, a broad oval nose, round belly and curved gripping paws.
A sloth hanging from a little branch with long curved arms, a masked face and three small claws.
A skunk with a high fluffy tail, a pale forehead stripe, pointed snout and small rounded ears.
A badger with a low broad body, small ears, bold paired face stripes and digging claws.
A bat with large pointed ears, scalloped outstretched wings, a little muzzle and tiny hanging feet.
An elephant with broad fan ears, a long curled trunk, short tusks and sturdy round feet.
A giraffe with little ossicones, leaf ears, a very long spotted neck and slender cloven legs.
A zebra with a short upright mane, pointed ears, striped face and legs and a tasseled tail.
A rhinoceros with a thick barrel body, folded ears, two nose horns and heavy three-toed feet.
A hippopotamus with tiny high-set ears and eyes, an enormous rounded muzzle and short wide feet.
A capybara with a blunt rectangular muzzle, tiny round ears, a relaxed face and a smooth barrel body.
A platypus with a broad flat duck bill, low rounded head, webbed feet and a smooth paddle tail.
An otter with small rounded ears, a pale muzzle and belly, little paws and a long tapering tail.
A seal with a round whiskered head, long smooth body, side flippers and paired rear flippers.
A dolphin with a long smiling beak, curved back, swept dorsal fin, side flipper and split tail flukes.
A shark with a tall triangular dorsal fin, pointed nose, gill slits, pale belly and a toothy smile.
A whale with a broad rounded head, a pale pleated belly, small flippers and wide tail flukes.
A jellyfish with a domed bell, scalloped rim, glowing spots and six gently curling tentacles.
A crab with raised split pincers, two eyestalks, a broad shell and six sideways walking legs.
A lobster with two big split claws, long antennae, a narrow segmented body and a fan tail.
A pufferfish with a round spiky body, tiny side fins, freckles and a small puckered mouth.
A fish with a fan tail, sweeping dorsal fin, striped scales, a small side fin and a smiling face.
An axolotl with six feathery external gills, a smiling round face, tiny limbs and a tall finned tail.
A five-armed starfish with rounded arm tips, a soft central face and small dotted tube-foot details.
An octopus with a rounded mantle, eight curling arms and little contrasting suckers.
A peacock with a broad fan of eye-spotted tail feathers, a little crest and a slender neck.
A flamingo with a long S-curved neck, a bent dark-tipped beak, one straight leg and one folded leg.
An eagle with a pale head, strong hooked beak, broad feathered wings and large talons.
A turkey with a scalloped striped fan tail, a little snood, hanging wattle and a plump body.
A dove with uplifted rounded wings, a little pointed beak, fanned tail and a tiny leafy sprig.
A crow with a stout straight bill, angular feathered wings, a wedge tail and sturdy feet.
A swan with a graceful long curved neck, small black-masked face, layered wing and swept tail.
A dodo with a bulbous hooked bill, plump flightless body, tiny curled wings and a tufted tail.
A hummingbird with a needle-like bill, swept hovering wings, tiny body and long forked tail.
A pelican with a huge long bill and hanging throat pouch, a broad body and webbed feet.
A toucan with an enormous rounded upper bill, pale throat, short wings and a long squared tail.
A puffin with round pale cheeks, a tall striped triangular bill, short dark wings and broad webbed feet.
An ostrich with a fluffy round body, long bare neck, tiny head and two very long two-toed legs.
A penguin with a pale oval belly, masked round face, downward flippers, little beak and webbed feet.
A frog with bulging eyes, broad smiling cheeks, folded hind legs and little spread toes.
A turtle with a domed hexagon-patterned shell, small smiling head, four flippers and a pointed tail.
A coiled snake with a raised S-curved neck, broad oval head, pale belly and little forked tongue.
A crocodile with a long toothy muzzle, high-set eyes, a ridged back and a sweeping armored tail.
A lizard with a tapered body, long curling tail, four splayed feet and little spotted scales.
A chameleon with a helmet-like crest, large swivel eye, arched back, grasping toes and spiral tail.
A snail with a large spiral shell, soft gliding foot, tall eyestalks and a smiling little head.
A caterpillar with round connected segments, many tiny feet, short feelers and a friendly round head.
A ladybug with a round spotted wing case, central wing seam, tiny feelers and six bent legs.
A cricket with long feelers, folded wing cases, oversized jointed hind legs and four small forelegs.
A spider with eight jointed walking legs, a round abdomen, a small head and four friendly eyes.
A scorpion with two split pincers, eight little legs, segmented armor and a raised curling tail.
A beetle with a broad shiny wing case, central seam, curved horn, little antennae and six jointed legs.
An ant with three distinct body sections, elbowed antennae, six walking legs and a striped abdomen.
A worm with a soft upright curving body, rounded head, a little collar and clear ringed segments.
A butterfly with four patterned rounded wings, slender segmented body and curled antennae.
A bee with two pairs of translucent-looking wings, striped abdomen, six little legs and short antennae.
A unicorn with a spiral horn, flowing mane, pointed ears, long muzzle and cloven hooves.
A dragon with little horns, scalloped wings, a finned tail, a rounded muzzle and a plated belly.
A griffin with an eagle head and hooked beak, lion haunches, feathered wings and a tufted tail.
A phoenix with a flame crest, outstretched feathered wings and three sweeping flame-shaped tail plumes.
A pegasus with a horse muzzle, upright ears, layered feather wings and a flowing tail.
A kitsune with pointed fox ears, cheek markings and five fan-shaped pale-tipped tails.
A jackalope with long rabbit ears, branching antlers, a cotton tail and broad hind paws.
A sea serpent with a finned head, long curving neck, scaly coils and a forked tail.
A friendly three-headed dog with floppy side ears, three distinct faces and four sturdy paws.
A baby yeti with shaggy fur, tiny horns, a soft pale face and oversized rounded feet.
A Loch Ness monster with a long raised neck, gentle small head, two back humps and flippers.
A mothman with enormous rounded eyes, small feelers, folded scalloped wings and soft fuzzy body.
A little dinosaur with a large smiling head, short forearms, thick hind legs and a long balancing tail.
A retro robot with a rounded television head, screen eyes, dial chest, ribbed arms and little wheels.
A tiny robot with a compact square head, little mitten hands, short body and wide small feet.
A tall robot with a slim rectangular head, narrow torso, long jointed legs and articulated hands.
A floating robot with an oval head, spherical body, side pods and two quiet hover rings.
A mushroom with a broad spotted cap, a little gilled underside and a smiling stalk.
A tree with a rounded leafy canopy, visible branches, a textured trunk and little roots.
A flower with six rounded petals, a cheerful central face, two leaves and a slender stem.
A cactus with two raised arms, a little flower, dotted spines and a small patterned pot.
A cloud with a soft rolling silhouette, three little lower wisps and a gentle smiling face.
A five-pointed angular star with bright inner facets and a small friendly face.
A crescent moon with a smooth inner curve, little crater marks and a sleepy smiling face.
A sun with eight pointed rays, a round face and a warm curved smile.
A flame with three pointed licking tips, a bright inner flicker and a small smiling face.
A water droplet with a pointed top, rounded base, sweeping highlight and gentle smile.
A rock with an uneven faceted outline, a broad front face and small mineral flecks.
A crystal with a tall pointed central prism, two smaller side shards and a softly smiling face.
A planet with a broad tilted orbit ring, cloud bands, small moonscape spots and a friendly face.
A coffee cup with a round handle, visible warm drink, a saucer and two quiet steam curls.
A teapot with a round belly, tall curved handle, angled pouring spout, lid and smiling face.
An open book with a colored cover, two curved page stacks, a central spine and a little ribbon.
A lightbulb with a rounded glowing head, curled filament, screw base and three small light rays.
A heart with two rounded lobes, a tapered point, a broad highlight and a gentle smiling face.
A friendly ghost with two waving arms, soft rounded head and a scalloped floating hem.
A UFO with a domed smiling cabin, broad saucer rim, round lights and three short landing struts.
